comment:
* Utility methods for parsing Dolby TrueHD and (E-)AC-3 syncframes. (E-)AC-3 parsing follows the
 * definition in ETSI TS 102 366 V1.4.1.

variables.name: AC3_MAX_RATE_BYTES_PER_SECOND
variables.comment: Maximum rate for an AC-3 audio stream, in bytes per second.

variables.name: E_AC3_MAX_RATE_BYTES_PER_SECOND
variables.comment: Maximum rate for an E-AC-3 audio stream, in bytes per second.

variables.name: TRUEHD_MAX_RATE_BYTES_PER_SECOND
variables.comment: Maximum rate for a TrueHD audio stream, in bytes per second.

variables.name: TRUEHD_RECHUNK_SAMPLE_COUNT
variables.comment:
* The number of samples to store in each output chunk when rechunking TrueHD streams. The number
   * of samples extracted from the container corresponding to one syncframe must be an integer
   * multiple of this value.

variables.name: TRUEHD_SYNCFRAME_PREFIX_LENGTH
variables.comment: * The number of bytes that must be parsed from a TrueHD syncframe to calculate the sample count.

variables.name: AUDIO_SAMPLES_PER_AUDIO_BLOCK
variables.comment: The number of new samples per (E-)AC-3 audio block.

variables.name: AC3_SYNCFRAME_AUDIO_SAMPLE_COUNT
variables.comment: Each syncframe has 6 blocks that provide 256 new audio samples. See subsection 4.1.

variables.name: BLOCKS_PER_SYNCFRAME_BY_NUMBLKSCOD
variables.comment: Number of audio blocks per E-AC-3 syncframe, indexed by numblkscod.

variables.name: BITRATE_BY_HALF_FRMSIZECOD
variables.comment: Nominal bitrates in kbps, indexed by frmsizecod / 2. (See table 4.13.)

variables.name: SYNCFRAME_SIZE_WORDS_BY_HALF_FRMSIZECOD_44_1
variables.comment: 16-bit words per syncframe, indexed by frmsizecod / 2. (See table 4.13.)

methods.name: public static Format parseAc3AnnexFFormat(ParsableByteArray data, String trackId, String language, @Nullable DrmInitData drmInitData)
methods.comment:
* Returns the AC-3 format given {@code data} containing the AC3SpecificBox according to Annex F.
   * The reading position of {@code data} will be modified.
   *
   * @param data The AC3SpecificBox to parse.
   * @param trackId The track identifier to set on the format.
   * @param language The language to set on the format.
   * @param drmInitData {@link DrmInitData} to be included in the format.
   * @return The AC-3 format parsed from data in the header.

methods.name: public static Format parseEAc3AnnexFFormat(ParsableByteArray data, String trackId, String language, @Nullable DrmInitData drmInitData)
methods.comment:
* Returns the E-AC-3 format given {@code data} containing the EC3SpecificBox according to Annex
   * F. The reading position of {@code data} will be modified.
   *
   * @param data The EC3SpecificBox to parse.
   * @param trackId The track identifier to set on the format.
   * @param language The language to set on the format.
   * @param drmInitData {@link DrmInitData} to be included in the format.
   * @return The E-AC-3 format parsed from data in the header.

methods.name: public static SyncFrameInfo parseAc3SyncframeInfo(ParsableBitArray data)
methods.comment:
* Returns (E-)AC-3 format information given {@code data} containing a syncframe. The reading
   * position of {@code data} will be modified.
   *
   * @param data The data to parse, positioned at the start of the syncframe.
   * @return The (E-)AC-3 format data parsed from the header.

methods.name: public static int parseAc3SyncframeSize(byte[] data)
methods.comment:
* Returns the size in bytes of the given (E-)AC-3 syncframe.
   *
   * @param data The syncframe to parse.
   * @return The syncframe size in bytes. {@link C#LENGTH_UNSET} if the input is invalid.

methods.name: public static int parseAc3SyncframeAudioSampleCount(ByteBuffer buffer)
methods.comment:
* Reads the number of audio samples represented by the given (E-)AC-3 syncframe. The buffer's
   * position is not modified.
   *
   * @param buffer The {@link ByteBuffer} from which to read the syncframe.
   * @return The number of audio samples represented by the syncframe.

methods.name: public static int findTrueHdSyncframeOffset(ByteBuffer buffer)
methods.comment:
* Returns the offset relative to the buffer's position of the start of a TrueHD syncframe, or
   * {@link C#INDEX_UNSET} if no syncframe was found. The buffer's position is not modified.
   *
   * @param buffer The {@link ByteBuffer} within which to find a syncframe.
   * @return The offset relative to the buffer's position of the start of a TrueHD syncframe, or
   *     {@link C#INDEX_UNSET} if no syncframe was found.

methods.name: public static int parseTrueHdSyncframeAudioSampleCount(byte[] syncframe)
methods.comment:
* Returns the number of audio samples represented by the given TrueHD syncframe, or 0 if the
   * buffer is not the start of a syncframe.
   *
   * @param syncframe The bytes from which to read the syncframe. Must be at least {@link
   *     #TRUEHD_SYNCFRAME_PREFIX_LENGTH} bytes long.
   * @return The number of audio samples represented by the syncframe, or 0 if the buffer doesn't
   *     contain the start of a syncframe.

methods.name: public static int parseTrueHdSyncframeAudioSampleCount(ByteBuffer buffer, int offset)
methods.comment:
* Reads the number of audio samples represented by a TrueHD syncframe. The buffer's position is
   * not modified.
   *
   * @param buffer The {@link ByteBuffer} from which to read the syncframe.
   * @param offset The offset of the start of the syncframe relative to the buffer's position.
   * @return The number of audio samples represented by the syncframe.

methods.name: private static int getAc3SyncframeSize(int fscod, int frmsizecod)
